pc_fill_sparse — 3D resolution op

• Data kinds: points → points

• Call: import meshres; meshres.pc_fill_sparse(points, spacing, k=8) (or ops3d.get("pc_fill_sparse"))

Usage

Insert points where the local spacing exceeds *spacing*, on the local PCA plane (`points`).
